name: framepack
description: A lightweight HyperFrames creative workbench for assets, prompts, composition, and iteration.
readme:
# Framepack

Framepack is an agent-native HyperFrames and Remotion video workbench. It turns rough user ideas, assets, references, and fuzzy taste words into a professional video plan that Codex or Claude Code can execute.

中文: Framepack turns requests like more business, faster pacing, bigger text, more animation, or like this reference into asset notes, human brief, style direction, template route, HyperFrames prompt-template, composition plan, and iteration memory.

Quick start:

```bash
npm install framepack
npx framepack create --idea "A premium launch video" --assets ./assets --output-dir ./out --project-name launch-video
npx framepack workbench brief --project-dir ./out/launch-video
npx framepack templates prompt --json
```

Read `FRAMEPACK.md` and `HUMAN.md` first. `HUMAN.md` is the plain-language user summary. `COMPOSITION.md` includes the selected Template Fusion Plan and HyperFrames Prompt Template. Claude Code project skills are installed under `.claude/skills`.

Full docs: https://github.com/ARTHUR-BBU/framepack
